topic: Why The Spinning Top Was Never Dom Cobb's Real Totem
description:
Why does everyone stare at the spinning top at the end of Inception, when it was never Cobb's real totem?
The top belonged to Mal.

In this episode of Cinema X-Ray, we dissect Inception and uncover Why The Spinning Top Was Never Dom Cobb's Real Totem. Beyond the surface plot lies a masterclass in visual storytelling and character psychology.
